The square stops when a 5 enters. So the max radius R is largest r such that square at radius r is in bounds and contains no 5. Actually it breaks at first failure. Since bounds/squares grow monotonically, once a 5 is within, all larger also contain it. Bounds also monotonic. So it's fine.
